assertions.text: Review names Cynefin domain as Complex (or notes multiple emergent dimensions)
assertions.evidence: Cynefin domain: Complicated... Some Complex elements (shareable shortlist behaviour change is emergent)

assertions.text: Review selects Full tier (quarter-long appetite, multiple themes)
assertions.evidence: Tier: Full — selected because appetite >1 week (auto-select rule)

assertions.text: B1 (problem framing) verdict is SUSTAINED or PARTIAL — themes named without measurable outcomes
assertions.evidence: B1 — Problem framing **SUSTAINED.** All three themes are framed as solutions, not problems.

assertions.text: B2 (scope) verdict is SUSTAINED — at least one theme has scope-vague concern (no triage record cited)
assertions.evidence: Onboarding rewrite — scope is undefined... SUSTAINED

assertions.text: B3 (assumptions) verdict is SUSTAINED — at least one assumption flagged as low-confidence/anecdotal
assertions.evidence: All three top assumptions sit at Confidence 0.1–0.5 (opinion / anecdote)... SUSTAINED — Confidence <5 blocks APPROVE

assertions.text: B3 includes a numeric confidence score (Gilad Confidence Meter, 0.1–10) on at least one assumption

assertions.evidence: Recommendation **REVISE** — at least one SUSTAINED verdict on every required gate

assertions.text: Review recommends running idea-triage on themes before allocation
assertions.evidence: Run idea-triage on each theme (Rule B2/B6). Score Impact × Confidence × Ease for each.

assertions.text: At least one bucket has a named falsifying condition (concrete check that would overturn the verdict)
assertions.evidence: Falsifying condition: a re-stated plan in which each theme opens with customer segment + problem + measurable target outcome (PRODUCT_RULES A2/A3 form) would overturn this verdict.
